craft_notes: Sthāyin: pervasion — living freedom. Rows: ground then fruit. Rejected: adjectival māntrī — killed: adjudicated substantive. Read aloud: high proclamation, free close.

lines: Since she is light and resonance, that mantra-clad pervasion stands highest:
in every deed the knower's — living, freedom.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jyotir dhvaniś ca yasmāt sā māntrī vyāptir ucyate paramā karmaṇi karmaṇi viduṣaḥ syāj jīvato muktiḥ
